model_TOA_uncertainty: Pre-CERES 1999 variance held fixed from 2001 onward in model-only components; historical ANT/total unchanged
component_percentile_convention: Aerosol uses historical aggregate percentile 85; GHG/ozone use the historical Gaussian-subset convention at percentile 17 with the same updated ERF release. Marginal subset percentiles are not additive joint quantiles.
component_extension: 1980-2014 linear fit plus seeded residual noise through selected end year; retained from original script
ozone_correction: o3 forcing replaces erroneous solar-column read
component_SE: Native filter SE; historical ANT includes production 1.2 current-output multiplier
uncertainty: Gaussian analytic marginal percentiles; not heads/tails ensemble uncertainty
OHF_alternatives: aerosol_proxy; ant_minus_GHG; aerosols_plus_ozone (partial non-GHG forcing). Combined widths assume independent components; covariance is unavailable.
legacy_OHFa: Unused legacy mean of aerosol/ozone runs; not a sum of forcing contributions
